title: Sports radio to try in Malta
intro: Radio snapshot for 13–19 October 2026. The clearest English-language sports lead is talkSPORT, carried on Malta DAB+ block 6C (185.360 MHz) under the service label “Sports Channel (Talk Sport)”: talkSPORT is an official Premier League audio broadcaster, so this is the first receiver scan to try on 17–18 October 2026. What the Malta relay actually carries, and its indoor reception, are unverified. Malta’s block 6A carries BBC World Service (Sportsworld, dated 17–18 October episodes, general live sport) plus Rai Radio Uno/Due/Tre, NET FM and Vibe HD; Vibe FM is the published radio partner of the Malta Premier League. The six BBC Radio 5 Live and 5 Sports Extra Premier League episode records remain UK-only schedule evidence. Kalshi’s own help centre says trading from many countries and while travelling abroad is possible subject to its Member Agreement, while third-party guidance conflicts; eligibility stays account-specific. No named-event carriage was verified.

The grid does not state its time zone and is recurring, not a date-stamped trip-week schedule. Recheck the station’s live schedule before travel. No TWC, Gżira United–Mosta, or Rolex Middle Sea Race radio carriage was confirmed. Also carried on Malta DAB+ block 6A (181.936 MHz) under the service name “Net FM”, per the Radio in Malta 6A station list read 11 October 2026: https://radioinmalta.com/en/dab/6a.php . This gives a second tuning route if the FM signal is weak inside the hotel.

records.name: talkSPORT — Malta DAB+ block 6C (service label “Sports Channel”)
records.area: Malta DAB+ block 6C (185.360 MHz) under the Digi B multiplex; reception at AX ODYCY and the Ta’ Qali venue not tested
records.address: Not applicable — broadcast service; tune by service name “Sports Channel” on block 6C
records.hours: No dated Malta trip-week schedule was published in the sources checked. talkSPORT’s UK output carries live Premier League commentary and around-the-clock sports talk; the relay’s own schedule could not be read remotely.
records.price range: Free-to-air if broadcast; DAB+ receiver required (hardware price not checked)
records.description: Three independent listings agree that a sports service is carried on Malta DAB+ block 6C: the specialist Radio in Malta directory names it “Sports Channel (Talk Sport)”, WorldDAB’s Malta multiplex table lists a “Sports Channel” DAB+ service on the Digi B multiplex, and Wikipedia’s talkSPORT article lists “DAB+: 6C (Malta)” among the station’s frequencies. talkSPORT is an official English Premier League audio broadcaster and the league’s global audio partner, which makes the 6C service the single most promising lead for English live football commentary on a radio in Malta during the 17–18 October fixture window. The unresolved step is what the Malta relay actually transmits: it could carry talkSPORT’s live match commentary or only its talk/analysis output, and rights scopes differ between the UK and international feeds. Scan block 6C first and confirm with the broadcast content itself.
records.notes: Read 11 October 2026: Radio in Malta’s 6C station list gives frequency 185.360 MHz, allotment MLT00018, on air since 2012, and lists “Sports Channel (Talk Sport)” at 32 kbps HE-AAC v2 alongside Capital (London), Gold (UK), Smooth Radio (UK), LBC 97.3, Jazz FM, XFM Malta, Opera Channel, EWTN, Vatican Radio, Radio Italia, Radio Margherita, All Country, All Dance HD and Magic Malta (HD): https://radioinmalta.com/en/dab/6c.php . WorldDAB’s Malta multiplex page lists a “Sports Channel” regular DAB+ service: https://www.worlddab.org/countries/malta/multiplexes . Wikipedia’s talkSPORT article lists the station’s DAB+ frequency for Malta as 6C: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Talksport . Malta’s three DAB+ blocks (6A, 6C, 12A) are operated by Digi B Network: https://www.worlddab.org/countries/malta and the MCA DAB+ consultation table: https://www.mca.org.mt/sites/default/files/MCA-C-21-4261%20-%20DAB%20Plus%20Consultation_0.pdf . Limitations: these are directory entries, not an operator schedule; the label is “Sports Channel” rather than the station name on some receivers; the 32 kbps bit rate is the directory’s figure; and no reception test or rights confirmation was possible. Do not present this as guaranteed live Premier League commentary — verify on a receiver in Malta.

records.name: Malta DAB+ tuning guide — blocks 6A, 6C and 12A
records.area: Malta and Gozo (national Digi B multiplexes); indoor reception varies by building
records.address: Not applicable — technical tuning data; scan by service name on a DAB+ receiver
records.hours: Not a schedule. Published block data: 6A 181.936 MHz (allotment MLT00017, on air since July 2008, transmitters Għargħur 10 kW and Żebbuġ, Gozo); 6C 185.360 MHz (allotment MLT00018, on air since 2012); 12A 223.936 MHz (Digi B 2).
records.description: Malta has used DAB+ (not older DAB) since 2008, with national coverage from the Digi B Network multiplexes on blocks 6A, 6C and 12A, so a DAB+-compatible receiver is required and should find the services by name rather than by dial frequency. Practical split for this trip: block 6A carries BBC World Service, Rai Radio Uno/Due/Tre, Net FM, Vibe HD and most Maltese services; block 6C carries the ‘Sports Channel’ (Talk Sport) service plus UK relays such as LBC 97.3, Capital, Gold, Smooth and Jazz FM. A one-touch scan of the three blocks is the fastest way to answer the radio question in Malta itself.
records.notes: Block and station data read 11 October 2026 from the Radio in Malta DAB+ pages: https://radioinmalta.com/en/dab/ , https://radioinmalta.com/en/dab/6a.php and https://radioinmalta.com/en/dab/6c.php . Corroborated by WorldDAB’s Malta country page and multiplex table (multiplexes operated by Digi B Network; coverage via 6A/6C/12A): https://www.worlddab.org/countries/malta and https://www.worlddab.org/countries/malta/multiplexes , and by the MCA’s DAB+ consultation frequency table: https://www.mca.org.mt/sites/default/files/MCA-C-21-4261%20-%20DAB%20Plus%20Consultation_0.pdf . Radio in Malta is a specialist enthusiast directory and WorldDAB is an industry association, so both are directory evidence, not the Maltese network operator’s live data: service names, bit rates and block contents can change, and reception inside a seafront hotel or a metal-framed studio building was not measured. Verify by scanning on arrival; the station list is not a programme guide.
records.price range: Broadcast reception is free; a DAB+ receiver is required (hardware not priced here). A pocket DAB+ receiver or a phone with a DAB+ accessory is the lightest option for a trip
